title: Craftsmanship Showcase
desc: Step-by-step visual narrative detailing fiber selection, hand-pattern cutting, double-needle stitching, and inspection.
heading: The Art of Master Tailoring
subtitle: Inside the four essential steps of our small-batch production process.

processSteps.title: Fiber Selection & Sorting
processSteps.description: Raw cashmere fibers are hand-sorted under magnification to select only 15.5 micron strands.

processSteps.title: Hand-Pattern Drafting
processSteps.description: Patterns are cut individually on heavy cardboard stock to ensure geometric precision.

processSteps.title: Double-Needle Hand Seaming
processSteps.description: Seams are joined using 12 stitches per inch with bonded nylon thread for burst strength.

processSteps.title: Final Steam & Inspection
processSteps.description: Garments are hand-steamed over wooden bucks and thoroughly inspected under 500-lux light.
